purpose: Choose the smallest selectable Dense-lead preview from saved governor bad cases without making a provider call.
diagnosed_problem: All four relevant Dense leads in the fresh governor slice were returned as a 24-token metadata stub ending at '--- title:'; none exposed the title value or was opened. Two queries had full gold recall but remained Judge-incorrect.

candidate.passage_selection: highest distinct search-query term overlap over bounded paragraph windows
candidate.reason_for_cap: At eight searches, 5*512 anchor tokens plus 15*64 lead tokens equals 28160, below the frozen 29184 search-ingress budget.

routing_rule: Pass permits one fresh, non-overlapping five-query answer-quality gate using the existing eight-search governor. Failure returns to preview extraction; do not add a Critic or multiple agents.
claim_boundary: This is a gold-informed bad-case calibration of evidence visibility, not an answer-quality experiment or official benchmark result.
